<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/v8.css">
<style>
.v8 .sgb[data-key="comp"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--blue)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="outil"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--coral)}
#segwrap .sgb{min-width:118px;text-align:center}

/* Interrupteur Radar/Chiffres : piste arrondie avec curseur glissant, comme le
   sélecteur R/Python des tutoriels — plus explicitement un "interrupteur"
   qu'une paire de boutons indépendants. */
.v8 .togglewrap{position:relative;display:flex;width:fit-content;padding:4px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(127,127,127,.1);border:1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.22);margin:14px auto 0}
.v8 .togglewrap .tg-indicator{position:absolute;top:4px;bottom:4px;left:4px;width:calc(50% - 4px);border-radius:999px;background:var(--txt);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.32,1);z-index:0}
.v8 .togglewrap .tgb{position:relative;z-index:1;width:152px;box-sizing:border-box;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;font-size:13.5px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--muted);background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 15px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s}
.v8 .togglewrap .tgb i{font-size:13px}
.v8 .togglewrap .tgb[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--onblue);font-weight:600}
.v8 .radwrap{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 14px}
.v8 .radwrap svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}
.v8 #polys circle{outline:none}
.v8 #polys circle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--txt);outline-offset:2px}
.v8 .donutwrap{max-width:440px;margin:14px auto 0}
.v8 .donutwrap svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}
.v8 .det strong{font-size:17px}
.v8 .det span{font-size:14px}
.v8 #donut circle[data-key]{cursor:pointer;outline:none;transition:stroke-opacity .2s,filter .2s}
.v8 #donut circle[data-key]:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.v8 #donut circle[data-key]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--txt);outline-offset:2px}
.v8 #donut text[data-key]{cursor:pointer;outline:none;transition:opacity .2s}

/* Bulle d'indice cliquable, mise en exergue par un léger sautillement de l'icône. */
.v8 .hint{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%}
.v8 .hint-icon{display:inline-block;color:var(--coral);font-size:15px;animation:hintBounce 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes hintBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-10deg)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v8 .hint-icon{animation:none}}

/* De vraies bulles rondes, assez grandes pour porter le texte des compétences. */
.v8 #bub .bb{width:142px;height:142px;border-radius:50%;padding:18px;box-sizing:border-box;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;flex:none}
.v8 #bubC .bb{width:118px;height:118px;border-radius:50%;padding:14px;box-sizing:border-box;flex:none}

/* Explorer : Parcours et Travaux en rectangles arrondis, étirés vers les bords,
   et "Explorer" au centre dans un cercle, encadré de chevrons vers l'un ou l'autre. */
.v8 .explorerow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:20px;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:44px 20px 44px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v8 .explorebtn{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;flex:1 1 220px;max-width:320px;height:96px;padding:0 30px;border-radius:28px;background:var(--panel);border:2px solid var(--hc);color:var(--txt);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.01em;transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease,background .2s ease;animation:exploreFloat 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.v8 .explorebtn:first-child{animation-delay:0s;justify-content:center}
.v8 .explorebtn:last-child{animation-delay:1.2s;justify-content:center}
.v8 .explorebtn-icon{font-size:30px;color:var(--hc)}
.v8 .explorebtn:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 22px 44px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5);background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--hc) 10%, var(--panel))}
.v8 .explorebtn-center{flex:0 0 auto;width:112px;height:112px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;flex-direction:row;gap:7px;background:var(--faint);border:2px dashed var(--line);cursor:default;animation:none}
.v8 .explorebtn-center-label{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--txt)}
.v8 .explore-arrow{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.v8 .explore-arrow-left{animation:exploreArrowLeft 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.v8 .explore-arrow-right{animation:exploreArrowRight 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes exploreArrowLeft{0%,100%{opacity:.45;transform:translateX(0)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-4px)}}
@keyframes exploreArrowRight{0%,100%{opacity:.45;transform:translateX(0)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(4px)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v8 .explorebtn{animation:none}.v8 .explore-arrow{animation:none}}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
var NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

var CX=260, CY=160, R=115;
var curLang=(window.localStorage && localStorage.getItem("site-lang")) || "fr";

// Compétences (6 axes) et Outils (4 axes) ont chacun leur propre géométrie —
// plus de superposition partagée depuis le retrait de la vue "Tout".
var COMP_ANG=[-90,-30,30,90,150,210].map(function(d){return d*Math.PI/180;});
var COMP_AXES_FR=["Analyse","Modélisation","Machine/Deep/AI","Expérimentation","Ingénierie","Communication"];
var COMP_AXES_EN=["Analysis","Modeling","Machine/Deep/AI","Experimentation","Engineering","Communication"];
var OUTIL_ANG=[-90,0,90,180].map(function(d){return d*Math.PI/180;});
var OUTIL_AXES_FR=["Langages de programmation","Logiciels","Infra et versioning","Restitution et reporting"];
var OUTIL_AXES_EN=["Programming languages","Software","Infra & Versioning","Reporting & Delivery"];

var S_FR={
 comp:{lab:"Compétences",col:"var(--blue)",v:[.75,.90,.85,.80,.78,.82],
  tip:["Collecte, nettoyage et exploration des données","Modèles statistiques classiques et spécialisés","Algorithmes de machine learning et deep learning","Validation, robustesse et fiabilité des modèles","Calcul, reproductibilité et mise en production","Transmettre et vulgariser les résultats"],
  it:[["Collecte de données","Gestion de valeurs manquantes","Construction de variables","Exploration de données"],
      ["Régression linéaire simple et multiple","Régression logistique","Modèles linéaires généralisés (GLM)","Modèles de survie","Analyse spatiale (krigeage)","Séries temporelles statistiques (ARIMA, SARIMA, GARCH)","Classification","Clustering","Réduction de dimension"],
      ["Arbres de décision","Random Forest","Gradient Boosting","SVM","KNN","K-Means","CAH","PCA","AFD","CNN","LLM"],
      ["Validation croisée","Métriques de performance","Optimisation des hyperparamètres","Régularisation","Gestion du biais et de la variance","Simulations","Monte Carlo/Bootstrap"],
      ["Big data","Calcul haute performance (HPC)","Reproductibilité/Mise en production","Versioning (Git)"],
      ["Restitution non technique","Enseignement et formation","Vulgarisation scientifique","Rédaction et publication"]]},
 outil:{lab:"Outils",col:"var(--coral)",v:[.85,.70,.70,.90],
  tip:["R, Python, SQL","Logiciels statistiques et économétriques","Git · Azure · HPC","Power BI · Tableau · Quarto"],
  it:[["R","Python","SQL"],
      ["Excel","GRETL","EVIEWS","SPAD","SPHYNX"],
      ["Git","Azure","HPC (clusters, calcul parallèle)"],
      ["Power BI","Tableau","LaTeX","Quarto","PowerPoint","Shiny"]]}
};
var S_EN={
 comp:{lab:"Skills",col:"var(--blue)",v:[.75,.90,.85,.80,.78,.82],
  tip:["Data collection, cleaning, and exploration","Classical and specialized statistical models","Machine learning and deep learning algorithms","Validating, stress-testing, and trusting models","Computing, reproducibility, and deployment","Sharing and explaining results"],
  it:[["Data collection","Missing value handling","Feature engineering","Data exploration"],
      ["Simple and multiple linear regression","Logistic regression","Generalized linear models (GLM)","Survival models","Spatial analysis (kriging)","Statistical time series (ARIMA, SARIMA, GARCH)","Classification","Clustering","Dimension reduction"],
      ["Decision trees","Random Forest","Gradient Boosting","SVM","KNN","K-Means","Hierarchical clustering (HAC)","PCA","LDA","CNN","LLM"],
      ["Cross-validation","Performance metrics","Hyperparameter optimization","Regularization","Bias-variance tradeoff","Simulations","Monte Carlo/Bootstrap"],
      ["Big data","High-performance computing (HPC)","Reproducibility/Production deployment","Version control (Git)"],
      ["Non-technical reporting","Teaching and training","Science communication","Writing and publishing"]]},
 outil:{lab:"Tools",col:"var(--coral)",v:[.85,.70,.70,.90],
  tip:["R, Python, SQL","Statistical and econometric software","Git · Azure · HPC","Power BI · Tableau · Quarto"],
  it:[["R","Python","SQL"],
      ["Excel","GRETL","EVIEWS","SPAD","SPHYNX"],
      ["Git","Azure","HPC (clusters, parallel computing)"],
      ["Power BI","Tableau","LaTeX","Quarto","PowerPoint","Shiny"]]}
};
var COMP_AXES=COMP_AXES_FR, OUTIL_AXES=OUTIL_AXES_FR, S=S_FR;
var filt="comp";
var curAngArr=COMP_ANG, curAxesArr=COMP_AXES;
function dataFor(k){ return S[k]; }
function pt(i,v){var a=curAngArr[i]; return [CX+R*v*Math.cos(a), CY+R*v*Math.sin(a)];}

// En chiffres : dérivé directement des listes d'éléments de "En graphique" —
// une catégorie du camembert par axe du filtre actif (Compétences ou Outils),
// avec pour total le nombre réel d'éléments de cet axe.
var AXIS_COLORS=["var(--blue)","var(--coral)","var(--third)","#3fbf7f","#a569bd","#e0629a"];
function categoriesFor(key){
  var s=S[key], axes = key==="outil" ? OUTIL_AXES : COMP_AXES;
  return axes.map(function(name,i){
    return {idx:i, lab:name, labLines:axisLabelLines(name), col:AXIS_COLORS[i%AXIS_COLORS.length],
      total:s.it[i].length, items:s.it[i]};
  });
}
var CX2=200, CY2=200, R2=98, SW=30, CIRC=2*Math.PI*R2;
var donut=document.getElementById("donut"), bubC=document.getElementById("bubC"),
    dTotal=document.getElementById("donutTotal"), dLabel=document.getElementById("donutLabel");
var donutSel=null;

function buildDonut(){
  donut.innerHTML="";
  var cats=categoriesFor(filt);
  var grandTotal=cats.reduce(function(a,c){return a+c.total;},0);
  var track=document.createElementNS(NS,"circle");
  track.setAttribute("cx",CX2); track.setAttribute("cy",CY2); track.setAttribute("r",R2);
  track.setAttribute("fill","none"); track.setAttribute("stroke","var(--faint)"); track.setAttribute("stroke-width",SW);
  donut.appendChild(track);
  var offset=0;
  cats.forEach(function(c){
    var len=(c.total/grandTotal)*CIRC;
    var seg=document.createElementNS(NS,"circle");
    seg.setAttribute("cx",CX2); seg.setAttribute("cy",CY2); seg.setAttribute("r",R2);
    seg.setAttribute("fill","none"); seg.setAttribute("stroke",c.col); seg.setAttribute("stroke-width",SW);
    seg.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", len.toFixed(1)+" "+(CIRC-len).toFixed(1));
    seg.setAttribute("stroke-dashoffset", (-offset).toFixed(1));
    seg.setAttribute("transform","rotate(-90 "+CX2+" "+CY2+")");
    seg.setAttribute("data-idx",c.idx);
    seg.setAttribute("tabindex","0"); seg.setAttribute("role","button");
    seg.setAttribute("aria-label",c.lab+" : "+c.total);
    seg.addEventListener("click",function(){donutSel=c.idx; renderChiffres();});
    seg.addEventListener("focus",function(){donutSel=c.idx; renderChiffres();});
    donut.appendChild(seg);

    var midAng=((offset+len/2)/CIRC)*360-90, rad=midAng*Math.PI/180;
    var r=R2+SW/2+42, lx=CX2+r*Math.cos(rad), ly=CY2+r*Math.sin(rad);
    var t=document.createElementNS(NS,"text");
    t.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle"); t.setAttribute("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
    t.setAttribute("fill",c.col); t.setAttribute("data-idx",c.idx); t.style.cursor="pointer";
    var startY = ly - c.labLines.length*6;
    c.labLines.forEach(function(line,li){
      var l=document.createElementNS(NS,"tspan"); l.setAttribute("x",lx.toFixed(1));
      if(li===0) l.setAttribute("y", startY.toFixed(1)); else l.setAttribute("dy","12");
      l.setAttribute("font-size","9.5"); l.setAttribute("font-weight","500"); l.textContent=line;
      t.appendChild(l);
    });
    var n=document.createElementNS(NS,"tspan"); n.setAttribute("x",lx.toFixed(1)); n.setAttribute("dy","18");
    n.setAttribute("font-size","17"); n.setAttribute("font-weight","700"); n.textContent=c.total;
    t.appendChild(n);
    t.addEventListener("click",function(){donutSel=c.idx; renderChiffres();});
    donut.appendChild(t);
    offset+=len;
  });
}

function renderChiffres(){
  var cats=categoriesFor(filt);
  var grandTotal=cats.reduce(function(a,c){return a+c.total;},0);
  donut.querySelectorAll("circle[data-idx]").forEach(function(el){
    var on=(donutSel===null || String(donutSel)===el.getAttribute("data-idx"));
    el.setAttribute("stroke-opacity", on?1:.2);
  });
  donut.querySelectorAll("text[data-idx]").forEach(function(el){
    var idx=el.getAttribute("data-idx");
    // Le libellé du secteur actif est déjà affiché au centre : on l'y masque pour éviter le doublon.
    el.style.opacity = donutSel===null ? 1 : (String(donutSel)===idx ? 0 : .35);
  });
  var active=donutSel===null?null:cats[donutSel];
  dTotal.textContent=active?active.total:grandTotal;
  dTotal.setAttribute("fill", active?active.col:"var(--txt)");
  var totalLabel = filt==="outil" ? (curLang==="en"?"tools, total":"outils, au total") : (curLang==="en"?"skills, total":"compétences, au total");
  dLabel.textContent=active?active.lab:totalLabel;

  bubC.innerHTML="";
  if(active){
    active.items.forEach(function(txt,n){
      var d=document.createElement("div"); d.className="bb"; d.textContent=txt;
      d.style.borderColor=active.col; d.style.color="var(--txt)";
      d.style.background="color-mix(in srgb, "+active.col+" 14%, transparent)";
      d.style.animationDelay=(n*60)+"ms";
      bubC.appendChild(d);
    });
  }
}

var web=document.getElementById("web"), axLabels=document.getElementById("axLabels");
function buildGrid(){
  web.innerHTML="";
  [.25,.5,.75,1].forEach(function(s){
    var p=document.createElementNS(NS,"polygon");
    p.setAttribute("points", curAngArr.map(function(a){return (CX+R*s*Math.cos(a)).toFixed(1)+","+(CY+R*s*Math.sin(a)).toFixed(1);}).join(" "));
    web.appendChild(p);
  });
  curAngArr.forEach(function(a){
    var l=document.createElementNS(NS,"line");
    l.setAttribute("x1",CX); l.setAttribute("y1",CY);
    l.setAttribute("x2",CX+R*Math.cos(a)); l.setAttribute("y2",CY+R*Math.sin(a));
    web.appendChild(l);
  });
}
// Coupe un libellé trop long en 2 lignes (sur un espace ou un tiret proche du
// milieu) pour qu'il ne dépasse jamais latéralement, quelle que soit sa longueur.
function axisLabelLines(name){
  if(name.length<=13) return [name];
  var mid=Math.floor(name.length/2), cut=-1;
  for(var d=0; d<mid; d++){
    if(" -".indexOf(name.charAt(mid-d))>=0){ cut=mid-d; break; }
    if(" -".indexOf(name.charAt(mid+d))>=0){ cut=mid+d; break; }
  }
  if(cut<0) return [name];
  var sep=name.charAt(cut);
  var a=name.slice(0, sep==="-"?cut+1:cut).trim();
  var b=name.slice(cut+1).trim();
  return (a && b) ? [a,b] : [name];
}
function buildAxLabels(){
  axLabels.innerHTML="";
  curAxesArr.forEach(function(name,i){
    var a=curAngArr[i], ca=Math.cos(a), sa=Math.sin(a), lx=CX+(R+24)*ca, ly=CY+(R+24)*sa;
    var lines=axisLabelLines(name);
    var t=document.createElementNS(NS,"text");
    t.setAttribute("x",lx.toFixed(1));
    t.setAttribute("fill","var(--txt)"); t.setAttribute("font-size","14.5");
    t.setAttribute("font-family","Inter,sans-serif"); t.setAttribute("font-weight","600");
    t.setAttribute("text-anchor", Math.abs(ca)<.3?"middle":(ca>0?"start":"end"));
    t.style.pointerEvents="none";
    var startY = lines.length>1 ? ly-3 : ly+4;
    lines.forEach(function(line,li){
      var ts=document.createElementNS(NS,"tspan");
      ts.setAttribute("x",lx.toFixed(1)); ts.setAttribute("y",(startY+li*17).toFixed(1));
      ts.textContent=line;
      t.appendChild(ts);
    });
    axLabels.appendChild(t);
  });
}

var polys=document.getElementById("polys"), det=document.getElementById("det"),
    bub=document.getElementById("bub");

function bubbles(key,i){
  var s=dataFor(key), list=s.it[i];
  det.innerHTML="<strong style='color:"+s.col+"'>"+curAxesArr[i]+" · "+s.lab+"</strong><span>"+list.length+(curLang==="en"?" items":" éléments")+"</span>";
  bub.innerHTML="";
  list.forEach(function(t,n){
    var d=document.createElement("div"); d.className="bb"; d.textContent=t;
    d.style.borderColor=s.col; d.style.color="var(--txt)";
    d.style.background="color-mix(in srgb, "+s.col+" 14%, transparent)";
    d.style.animationDelay=(n*60)+"ms";
    bub.appendChild(d);
  });
}
function applyFilter(k){
  filt=k;
  donutSel=null;
  segGroup.querySelectorAll(".sgb").forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", x.getAttribute("data-key")===filt);});
  draw();
  buildDonut();
  renderChiffres();
}
function selectVertex(k,i){
  bubbles(k,i);
}
function draw(){
  curAngArr = filt==="outil" ? OUTIL_ANG : COMP_ANG;
  curAxesArr = filt==="outil" ? OUTIL_AXES : COMP_AXES;
  buildGrid();
  buildAxLabels();
  polys.innerHTML=""; bub.innerHTML="";
  det.innerHTML="<strong>"+S[filt].lab+"</strong>";
  var s=dataFor(filt);
  var p=document.createElementNS(NS,"polygon");
  p.setAttribute("points", s.v.map(function(v,i){return pt(i,v).map(function(n){return n.toFixed(1);}).join(",");}).join(" "));
  p.setAttribute("fill",s.col); p.setAttribute("fill-opacity",.18);
  p.setAttribute("stroke",s.col); p.setAttribute("stroke-width",2); p.setAttribute("stroke-opacity",.95);
  polys.appendChild(p);
  s.v.forEach(function(v,i){
    var q=pt(i,v);
    var h=document.createElementNS(NS,"circle");
    h.setAttribute("cx",q[0]); h.setAttribute("cy",q[1]); h.setAttribute("r",9);
    h.setAttribute("fill",s.col); h.setAttribute("class","halo");
    h.style.animationDelay=(i*160)+"ms"; h.style.pointerEvents="none";
    polys.appendChild(h);
    var c=document.createElementNS(NS,"circle");
    c.setAttribute("cx",q[0]); c.setAttribute("cy",q[1]); c.setAttribute("r",5);
    c.setAttribute("fill",s.col); c.setAttribute("stroke","var(--bg)"); c.setAttribute("stroke-width",1.6);
    c.setAttribute("tabindex","0"); c.setAttribute("role","button");
    c.setAttribute("aria-label",curAxesArr[i]+", "+s.lab+" : "+s.tip[i]); c.style.cursor="pointer";
    var onPick = function(){ selectVertex(filt,i); };
    c.addEventListener("click",onPick);
    c.addEventListener("focus",onPick);
    polys.appendChild(c);
  });
}
var FILTER_LABELS={fr:["Compétences","Outils"], en:["Skills","Tools"]};
var segwrap=document.getElementById("segwrap");
var segGroup=document.createElement("div"); segGroup.className="seg"; segGroup.setAttribute("role","group");
segwrap.appendChild(segGroup);
function buildFilterButtons(){
  segGroup.innerHTML="";
  var lab=FILTER_LABELS[curLang];
  segGroup.setAttribute("aria-label",lab[0]+(curLang==="en"?" and ":" et ")+lab[1].toLowerCase());
  [["comp",lab[0]],["outil",lab[1]]].forEach(function(f){
    var b=document.createElement("button"); b.className="sgb"; b.textContent=f[1];
    b.setAttribute("data-key",f[0]);
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", f[0]===filt);
    b.onclick=function(){applyFilter(f[0]);};
    segGroup.appendChild(b);
  });
}
buildFilterButtons();
draw();
buildDonut();
renderChiffres();

var toggleEl=document.getElementById("toggle"), hintTextEl=document.getElementById("hintText"),
    viewRadar=document.getElementById("viewRadar"), viewChiffres=document.getElementById("viewChiffres");
var HINTS={
  fr:{radar:"Cliquez sur un sommet pour voir ce qu'il contient", chiffres:"Cliquez sur une part du camembert pour voir le détail"},
  en:{radar:"Click a vertex to see what it contains", chiffres:"Click a pie slice to see the detail"}
};
var TOGGLE_LABELS={fr:["En graphique","En chiffres"], en:["As a chart","By the numbers"]};
var view="radar";
function setView(v){
  view=v;
  viewRadar.classList.toggle("on", v==="radar");
  viewChiffres.classList.toggle("on", v==="chiffres");
  hintTextEl.textContent=HINTS[curLang][v];
  toggleEl.querySelectorAll(".tgb").forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.dataset.view===v);});
  var indicator=toggleEl.querySelector(".tg-indicator");
  if(indicator) indicator.style.transform = v==="chiffres" ? "translateX(100%)" : "translateX(0)";
}
function buildToggleButtons(){
  toggleEl.innerHTML="";
  var indicator=document.createElement("span"); indicator.className="tg-indicator";
  toggleEl.appendChild(indicator);
  var lab=TOGGLE_LABELS[curLang];
  [["radar",lab[0],"bi-bar-chart-line"],["chiffres",lab[1],"bi-123"]].forEach(function(f){
    var b=document.createElement("button"); b.className="tgb"; b.dataset.view=f[0];
    b.innerHTML="<i class='bi "+f[2]+"'></i>"+f[1];
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", f[0]===view);
    b.onclick=function(){setView(f[0]);};
    toggleEl.appendChild(b);
  });
}
buildToggleButtons();
setView("radar");

window.addEventListener("sitelangchange", function(e){
  curLang=e.detail.lang;
  COMP_AXES = curLang==="en" ? COMP_AXES_EN : COMP_AXES_FR;
  OUTIL_AXES = curLang==="en" ? OUTIL_AXES_EN : OUTIL_AXES_FR;
  S = curLang==="en" ? S_EN : S_FR;
  curAxesArr = filt==="outil" ? OUTIL_AXES : COMP_AXES;
  donutSel=null;
  buildFilterButtons();
  buildToggleButtons();
  draw();
  buildDonut();
  renderChiffres();
  setView(view);
});
})();
</script>
